verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator documents its own export: a QR code created on the old device and scanned on a new one. A community user confirms it can export all saved codes into one QR code, but only for re-import into Google Authenticator on another device. Nothing shows the export uses an open, human-readable format that other apps can import, and one user says getting a simple text export to a file is 'stupendously difficult'. missing for 10: an open, readable export format (e.g. plaintext or otpauth URIs to a file), documented import into competing apps, independent confirmation of portability away from Google.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: On your old device, create a QR code... On your new device, tap Scan QR code
Google Authenticator has a feature to allow export of all saved codes into one QR code for re-import into Google Authenticator running on another device.
